### Limitations
- Query [q1] aggregates revenue across all recorded records; temporal coverage and date completeness were not measured.
- Item counts, order counts, and distinct customer counts were not queried, so transaction and volume scale cannot be determined.
- Revenue was not segmented by individual authorized product (`product_id` 2 vs. 3).

### Action items (proposed)
- Propose querying Complete revenue broken down by `product_id` to assess performance differences between authorized products.
- Propose calculating item and order counts alongside revenue to measure order volume and average item selling price.
- Propose grouping Complete revenue into date buckets (e.g., by month or year) to evaluate revenue trajectory over time.
